name: Stereolabs ZED Mini
description: Small USB-C stereo camera with dual 4 MP rolling-shutter sensors, 63 mm baseline and a built-in IMU; depth is computed on the host GPU by the ZED SDK.

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Dual 1/3" 4 MP CMOS, 2688 × 1520, synchronized rolling shutter

specs.label: Interface / power
specs.value: USB 3.0 Type-C; 5 V, 1.9 W typical (0.38 A)

envelope.axes: datasheet summary 124.5 × 30.5 × 26.5 mm; drawing: body 125.2 wide × 26.6 tall, 13 mm body depth, 30.25 mm deep including the lens bosses

features.label: Lens positions
features.value: Lens centers 63 mm apart. Top view: lens bosses 18.78 mm and 20.53 mm wide (dimension lines), the left boss 1.72 mm from the end; body 14.44 mm vs 13 mm deep at the two ends of the top view; the bosses bring total depth to 30.25 mm

features.label: Top mounting
features.value: 2× M2×0.4 (Ø2), max screw engagement 2.3 mm, 56 mm apart on the top face (used by the VR headset mount)

features.label: Rear mounting
features.value: Holes at 116.7 × 18.1 mm on the back face, M2×0.4, max 2.3 mm (callout reads 'Ø2 02x' although four holes are drawn)

features.label: Connector
features.value: USB-C on the left end face, 9.5 mm opening; end view 23.17 mm

features.label: Tripod
features.value: No 1/4-20 thread shown on the drawing

notes: Amazon search for 'Stereolabs ZED Mini' returned 'No results'; sold direct by Stereolabs and Mouser. Weight: datasheet 62.9 g, 3dmodels page 60 g. The drawing's hole callouts ('Ø2 02x … Use M2X0.4') conflict with four holes drawn on the rear view; check against the STEP once downloaded.
